Convert georeferenced UCDP data to an sf object

Source: R/spatial.R
ucdp_as_sf.Rd

ucdp_as_sf() recognizes common UCDP coordinate columns and converts them to point geometry. The original ucdp_source provenance attribute is retained, making the result suitable for later spatial joins, including workflows built around the released priogrid package or a future priogridR package.

Usage

ucdp_as_sf(
  data,
  longitude = NULL,
  latitude = NULL,
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE,
  missing = c("keep", "drop", "error")
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing coordinates, or an existing sf object.

longitude, latitude

Coordinate column names. When omitted, common UCDP names are detected automatically.

crs

Coordinate reference system passed to sf::st_as_sf(). UCDP GED coordinates use EPSG 4326.

remove

Remove the source coordinate columns?

missing

How to handle missing coordinates: retain them as empty geometries, drop their rows, or raise an error.

Value

An sf object with point geometry.

Examples

events <- data.frame(
  id = 1:3, longitude = c(10, 20, NA), latitude = c(50, 60, NA)
)
if (requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE)) {
  events_sf <- ucdp_as_sf(events, missing = "drop")
  sf::st_crs(events_sf)
}
#> Coordinate Reference System:
#>   User input: EPSG:4326
